verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's own marketing says you can share unique checkout links or embed its checkout and sell anywhere. It also says it handles payments, offers up to 21 payment methods, and uses local-currency pricing to increase checkout conversions, so no custom payment UI is needed. The evidence is marketing-level only: missing for 10: in-depth docs on hosted checkout and programmatic redirect/checkout-URL creation, specifics of checkout conversion optimization beyond local currency, independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted checkout experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique checkout links** and sell anywhere
Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**.
you can **accept up to 21 payment methods**, including PayPal, all under one roof.
**we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax** without you lifting a finger.
